Class RemoteGameServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
mesos.server.RemoteGameServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Remote, RemoteGameService
public class RemoteGameServiceImpl extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RemoteGameService
RMI remote object: the server-side access point for RMI clients. Bound in the RMI registry under the name "mesos-game" by ServerMain.

      public String login(String nick, RemoteGameCallback callback) throws RemoteException
      Description copied from interface: RemoteGameService
      Registers the client. Returns "LOBBY_FIRST" if this client must set the player count, or "LOBBY_JOINED n/m" otherwise. Throws RemoteException on NICKNAME_TAKEN.

    • setNumPlayers

      public void setNumPlayers(int n) throws RemoteException
      Description copied from interface: RemoteGameService
      Sets the expected player count. Called only by the first client after LOBBY_FIRST. Throws RemoteException if n is not in [2, 5].
